function loadScript(url, options = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const {
      async = true,
      defer = false,
      crossOrigin = 'anonymous',
      integrity = null,
      timeout = 10000,
      id = null,
      onProgress = null,
    } = options;

    const existingScript = document.querySelector(`script[src="${url}"]`);
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log(`Script already loaded: ${url}`);
      resolve({ status: 'already_loaded', url });
      return;
    }

    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = url;
    script.async = async;
    script.defer = defer;

    if (crossOrigin) {
      script.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
    }

    if (integrity) {
      script.integrity = integrity;
    }

    if (id) {
      script.id = id;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      script.remove();
      reject(new Error(`Timeout loading script: ${url}`));
    }, timeout);

    script.onload = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      console.log(`Script loaded successfully: ${url}`);
      resolve({ status: 'loaded', url, script });
    };

    script.onerror = (error) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      script.remove();
      reject(new Error(`Failed to load script: ${url}`));
    };

    if (onProgress && typeof onProgress === 'function') {
      script.onprogress = onProgress;
    }

    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });
}

function loadStyle(url, options = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const {
      crossOrigin = 'anonymous',
      integrity = null,
      media = 'all',
      id = null,
    } = options;

    const existingLink = document.querySelector(`link[href="${url}"]`);
    if (existingLink) {
      console.log(`Style already loaded: ${url}`);
      resolve({ status: 'already_loaded', url });
      return;
    }

    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
    link.href = url;
    link.media = media;

    if (crossOrigin) {
      link.crossOrigin = crossOrigin;
    }

    if (integrity) {
      link.integrity = integrity;
    }

    if (id) {
      link.id = id;
    }

    link.onload = () => {
      console.log(`Style loaded successfully: ${url}`);
      resolve({ status: 'loaded', url, link });
    };

    link.onerror = () => {
      link.remove();
      reject(new Error(`Failed to load style: ${url}`));
    };

    document.head.appendChild(link);
  });
}
